name: Konohana
source:
Main character is the master of the luxurious mansion with vast garden in blossom. Two cute maids serve him - gentle older Haruna and cheerful noisy Natsumi. It's a beautiful spring day to spend in this atmosphere.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一座豪华宅邸的主人，宅邸拥有一片繁花盛开的广阔庭园。两位可爱的女仆服侍着他，一位是温柔的年长女仆春菜，另一位是开朗吵闹的夏实。在这样美好的氛围中，正适合度过一个明媚的春日。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
